Title: NETMESSAGE:Commander: Group! There seems to be an additional mechanism that keeps the gate closed.
Translation: 指挥官：各位！似乎还有一个额外的机制让门关着。

Title: NETMESSAGE:It has to be over now. Lets try the gate's lever again!
Translation: 现在应该结束了。我们再试试大门的拉杆吧！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Looks like a sphinx!/nWe still need to find that mechanism that keeps the gate closed.
Translation: 看起来像斯芬克斯！/n我们还需要找到那个让门关着的机制。

Title: NETMESSAGE:This place is falling apart! We should run back to the gate as soon as possible!
Translation: 这个地方快塌了！我们得尽快跑回大门！

Title: NETMESSAGE:We have blown up a way close to you. Be careful down there!
Translation: 我们炸开了一条离你近的路。小心下面！
